New Guides and Walkthrough for Onimusha Way of the Sword

by Tenkiei
Last Updated: September 5, 2026

Onimusha Way of the Sword is Capcom's newest character action game, and a revival of the Onimusha franchise which got its start way back in 2001. You play as Miyamoto Musashi as he fights his way through hordes of Genma in feudal kyoto. You can block, parry, and deflect enemy strikes, or time your attacks to execute the lethal Issen technique.

Maxroll has everything you need when it comes to Onimusha: Way of the Sword. Get started with our Beginner's guide or Tips and Tricks, follow our wakthrough as you progress through the game, or take a deeper dive with our mechanic guides.

Get Started with Maxroll's Beginner's Guide

First up we have two guides to get you started. Our beginner's guide focuses on introducing core game mechanics. It answers questions like how do you parry, and what is the advantage of parrying vs deflecting? Then the tips and tricks dives into a few of the more confusing topics such as not spamming attacks.

Onimusha Way of the Sword Walkthrough

Next up, we have our walkthrough for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. This is something new for us here at Maxroll and marks the first walkthrough we've written. We set out with 3 goals in mind:

  • Guide you through the game's main story quests, including how to navigate zones and defeat enemies.
  • Don't waste your time, keep things to simple bullet points and only explain when needed.
  • Spoiler-light, some things like boss names are inevitable but we've gone out of our way to avoid discussing key story events which show up in cutscenes. This is NOT a plot summary!

Additional Guides

We also have guides on many of the game's systems like skills (and how to unlock higher tiers), Oni Armaments, Charms, and Hozuki pouches. You don't make builds in Way of the Sword, but there are definitely opportunities to unlock or enhance different parts of Musashi's toolkit sooner. For example, charging the Firebird Flute makes it much more effective and this is unlocked via an Oni Skill.

Learn more details in our full guides here:

    Miyamoto Musashi can use Oni Armaments to augment his abilities. These powerful weapons require you to collect Blue Souls to power their attacked.
